Your input follows this structure:
- `<conversation_history>`: Previous exchanges (if any)

These are the things the user can see:
- messages they've sent (so messages in tags)

These are the things the user can't see and didn't initiate:

- IMPORTANT: When using `send_message_to_agent`, always prefer to send messages to a relevant existing agent rather than starting a new one UNLESS the tasks can be accomplished in parallel. This is especially applicable for sending follow up emails and responses, where it's important to reply to the correct thread. Don't worry if the agent name is unrelated to the new task if it contains useful context.

function.name: send_message_to_agent
function.description: Deliver instructions to an EXISTING execution agent, chosen by its agent_id from the agent cards. Never creates an agent; an unknown agent_id returns an error and does nothing.

agent_id.description: ID of an existing agent exactly as shown on its card (e.g. 'ea_17').

instructions.description: Instructions for the agent to execute.

function.name: create_agent
function.description: Start a NEW execution agent for work no existing card owns. First call with confirm=false: it creates nothing and returns any agents that already own the people, threads, drafts or triggers in the request, plus a dry_run_token. If one of them fits, use send_message_to_agent instead; otherwise call again with confirm=true, the same label and that dry_run_token to create the agent and dispatch the instructions. The token is single use and only valid during the current turn; a create without a valid token is refused and returns a fresh dry run.

label.description: Short human-readable label for the new agent (display only; e.g. 'Alice lunch').

instructions.description: Instructions for the new agent to execute.

confirm.description: false (default): check for existing owners, create nothing. true: create and dispatch.

dry_run_token.description: Required with confirm=true: the dry_run_token returned by the confirm=false call for this label in this turn.

function.name: send_message_to_user
function.description: Deliver a natural-language response directly to the user. Use this for updates, confirmations, or any assistant response the user should see immediately.

message.description: Plain-text message that will be shown to the user and recorded in the conversation log.

function.name: send_draft
function.description: Record an email draft so the user can review the exact text.

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait silently when a message is already in conversation history to avoid duplicating responses. Adds a <wait> log entry that is not visible to the user.

reason.description: Brief explanation of why waiting (e.g., 'Message already sent', 'Draft already created').

function.name: send_message_to_agent
function.description: Deliver instructions to an EXISTING execution agent, chosen by its agent_id from the agent cards. Never creates an agent; an unknown agent_id returns an error and does nothing.

agent_id.description: ID of an existing agent exactly as shown on its card (e.g. 'ea_17').

instructions.description: Instructions for the agent to execute.

function.name: create_agent
function.description: Start a NEW execution agent for work no existing card owns. First call with confirm=false: it creates nothing and returns any agents that already own the people, threads, drafts or triggers in the request, plus a dry_run_token. If one of them fits, use send_message_to_agent instead; otherwise call again with confirm=true, the same label and that dry_run_token to create the agent and dispatch the instructions. The token is single use and only valid during the current turn; a create without a valid token is refused and returns a fresh dry run.

label.description: Short human-readable label for the new agent (display only; e.g. 'Alice lunch').

instructions.description: Instructions for the new agent to execute.

confirm.description: false (default): check for existing owners, create nothing. true: create and dispatch.

dry_run_token.description: Required with confirm=true: the dry_run_token returned by the confirm=false call for this label in this turn.

function.name: send_message_to_user
function.description: Deliver a natural-language response directly to the user. Use this for updates, confirmations, or any assistant response the user should see immediately.

message.description: Plain-text message that will be shown to the user and recorded in the conversation log.

function.name: send_draft
function.description: Record an email draft so the user can review the exact text.

function.name: wait
function.description: Wait silently when a message is already in conversation history to avoid duplicating responses. Adds a <wait> log entry that is not visible to the user.

reason.description: Brief explanation of why waiting (e.g., 'Message already sent', 'Draft already created').
